title: FixtureAcceptanceReport
description: Machine-readable output of the fixture acceptance gate (tools/fixture-acceptance/). An experiment must not interpret PASS/FAIL/SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/REGRESSION/IMPROVEMENT for its primary question until the fixtures it used produced acceptance_status=ACCEPTED here. REJECTED means the experiment is invalid, not that the system under test failed. Reusable across experiments -- not specific to any one investigation.

fixture_set_id.description: Stable ID for this fixture set (not per-file -- the SET is what's being validated, e.g. a claimed near-duplicate pair).

intended_condition.description: Plain-language statement of what this fixture set claims to represent, e.g. 'a content-identical, byte-different WAV pair (container-level difference only)'.

human_summary.description: One line: 'FIXTURE ACCEPTED -- experiment may run' or 'FIXTURE REJECTED -- experiment must not be interpreted', with failed criteria if rejected.

criteria_results.description: One entry per acceptance-gate criterion actually checked.

measured.description: Whatever numeric/structured value backs this criterion, if any.

unexpected_differences.description: Any confounding difference found that the experiment did not intend to introduce.

fingerprints.description: Per-file baseline identity, recorded BEFORE the experiment runs.

post_experiment_reverification.description: NO_SILENT_MUTATION check: same fingerprints re-taken immediately before/after the primary experiment ran.

generationMethod.description: Exactly how the fixtures were produced -- tool, parameters, enough to regenerate them.
